title: Separate Super Admin, BNA School Workspace, One Time connector, and Agent Action drop-off

source_prs.purpose: Port only safe focused BNA school admin semantics.

requirements.title: Create clean isolated worktree, branch, and draft PR
requirements.acceptance: Work is based on current master, PR #134/#138 refs are inspected without mechanical merge, branch is pushed, and a draft PR targets master.

requirements.title: Implement canonical platform taxonomy and compatibility resolver
requirements.acceptance: Super Admin is platform_control/platform_operations/platform_super_admin, BNA is bna_school, One Time is one_time/one_time_mishnayos, aliases resolve without destructive database rename, and migration plan is recorded.

requirements.title: Expose normal workspace switcher and routes
requirements.acceptance: Normal operator navigation offers Super Admin, BNA, and One Time without View-as/impersonation as the primary model; /operations, /operations/school, /operations/workspaces/one-time, and /operations/agent-actions are app-visible.

requirements.title: Port safe BNA school workspace surface
requirements.acceptance: /operations/school renders a focused BNA school workspace and uses a bounded BNA school summary API without exposing One Time/provider records.

requirements.title: Create reusable Agent Action job/drop-off architecture
requirements.acceptance: Agent Action routes/API exist, support the required job contract/statuses/categories, preserve Agent Review behavior, and enforce save plus readback before completion.

requirements.title: Implement safe One Time HighLevel queue importer
requirements.acceptance: Importer pins onetimev2 repo/ref/SHA, validates/fingerprints schema, deduplicates jobs, imports no secrets, performs no GHL execution, preserves canonical prompt text, and records One Time registry version.
requirements.blocker: Requested source artifact integrations/highlevel/agent-mode/GHL-AGENT-MODE-EXPORT.json was not present on PR #93 SHA 977e4453c34684cd06359f663d0e8f50dc3645f5 or scanned HighLevel descendant branches.

requirements.title: Correct ticket-routing taxonomy
requirements.acceptance: Live class questions, HighLevel-owned business conversations, and Super Admin technical tickets are distinct; One Time technical issues are not owned by BNA School; One Time operation does not depend on platform ticket availability.

requirements.title: Register routes/actions and run focused validation
requirements.acceptance: Route/action registries cover new visible controls, focused taxonomy/route/Agent Action tests pass, changed JS parses, secrets audit passes, and git diff is whitespace-clean.

requirements.title: Provide isolated app preview without production deployment
requirements.acceptance: An isolated local or PR environment preview shows Super Admin, BNA workspace, One Time connector, Agent Action queue, and the GHL import blocker/dry-run status without changing production.
